sentence_first_pass.correction_source_policy: The completed row-by-row audit is authoritative. Every rank must resolve to KEEP, CORRECT, REPLACE, or NATIVE_REVIEW. Corrections and replacements must be promoted from the audited row decision, not independently re-derived during regeneration.

source_policy: Natural learner language outranks artificial uniqueness; legitimate homographs are allowed when meaning and grammatical role differ.
release_gate: Do not treat this release as learner/publication ready until all 3,000 row decisions are compiled and resolved, approved corrections/replacements are applied from those decisions, all language artifacts are regenerated, deterministic regression QA passes, and independent native/editorial review is completed.
